### Surrendering to Obedience
Author: Jill Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-women/surrendering-to-obedience-one-year-devotions-for-women-june-8.html
Passage: Ezekiel 24:16
Points:
- Ezekiel was called to warn the Israelites of the tragic consequences resulting from their disobedience.
- Those who serve God are sometimes asked to sacrifice their personal comfort to fulfill their public calling.
- When Ezekiel's cherished wife died suddenly, God commanded him to refrain from tears and customary public mourning.
- This suppression of outward grief foreshadowed the shock and speechlessness Israel would feel when the temple was destroyed.
- When completely surrendered to God, personal grief and hardship can become a powerful vehicle for ministry.

### The Death of Ezekiel's Wife
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/death-ezekiels-wife
Passage: Ezekiel 24:15–27
Points:
- Ministers of God are frequently called to give up things they hold dearly in service to the Lord.
- Ezekiel was told his beloved wife would die, but he was forbidden from wearing mourning attire or shedding tears.
- By putting on celebratory headwear rather than mourning clothes, Ezekiel acted out a living prophecy for the exiles.
- The sudden loss prefigured the destruction of Jerusalem's temple, which was the supreme delight of the people's eyes.
- God works through severe earthly losses and short-term suffering to draw His people toward genuine repentance and salvation.

### Bible Pathways 09/07/2003
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-09-or-07-or-2003-1217362.html
Passage: Ezekiel 24:16
Points:
- God revealed to Ezekiel that his wife would die and instructed him not to engage in traditional mourning rites.
- Ezekiel's private sorrow was set aside to point to the far graver tragedy facing the nation and the temple.
- His refusal to mourn openly captured the community's attention and prompted them to ask for the meaning of his behavior.
- The impending loss of their loved ones and sanctuary would leave the exiles too stunned by judgment to weep normally.
- Believers should examine their priorities, mourning spiritual neglect rather than simply grieving earthly and material losses.
